sites.name: Quang Tri Ancient Citadel
sites.event: The site of the fierce 81-day-and-night battle (the Red Summer of 1972) to defend the ancient citadel, a heroic and tragic epic of the nation.

sites.name: Hien Luong - Ben Hai Banks Special National Relic Site
sites.event: A symbol of the pain of division between the South and the North during 20 years of war (the 17th parallel) and the aspiration for national reunification.

place.commune: Hien Thanh Commune (North bank) and Trung Hai Commune (South bank)
place.district: Vinh Linh District, Gio Linh District

sites.name: Vinh Moc Tunnels
sites.event: A magnificent underground structure, an 'underground village' where the military and people of Vinh Linh lived and fought safely under a rain of bombs and bullets.

sites.name: Truong Son National Martyrs Cemetery
sites.event: The eternal resting place of more than 10,000 martyrs who sacrificed their lives on the legendary Truong Son trail.

sites.name: Ta Con Airfield (Khe Sanh Relic Site)
sites.event: An important base in the US Route 9 - Khe Sanh defense system, where the earth-shaking Battle of Khe Sanh (1968) took place.

sites.name: Con Co Island
sites.event: Known as the 'Outpost Lookout' in the East Sea, twice awarded the title of Hero of the People's Armed Forces.

sites.name: Our Lady of La Vang Pilgrimage Center
sites.event: The national Marian center of the Catholic Church in Vietnam, marking the apparition of Our Lady in 1798.

sites.name: Cua Tung Beach
sites.event: Once dubbed the 'Queen of Beaches' by the French thanks to its fine sand and pristine beauty.

sites.name: Lao Bao Prison
sites.event: One of the largest prisons in Indochina, where the French colonialists imprisoned many key revolutionaries (To Huu, Nguyen Chi Thanh...).

sites.name: Headquarters of the Provisional Revolutionary Government of the Republic of South Vietnam
sites.event: The headquarters of the PRG from 1973 to 1975 after the Paris Peace Accords were signed, hosting many heads of state (Fidel Castro).

sites.name: Mui Treo
sites.event: A cliff jutting out into the sea at a height of dozens of meters, located between the Ru Bau primeval forest and the blue sea, a famous camping spot.

sites.name: Ta Puong Waterfall
sites.event: A majestic waterfall system located deep in the old forest, where Ta Puong Cave was once a food storage facility during the war.
